svg.title: Red-Orange
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; standardized vivid screen colours. Observed five-corner inverted triangular form, including both clipped upper corners. Palette groups the observed red-orange as orange. Overall landscape aspect uses the museum dimensions in observed orientation, corroborated by a US Art in Embassies catalogue; conflicting dimension order and half-inch short-side discrepancy remain unresolved, so true-scale use is disabled.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.moca.org/artworks/red-orange; object 85.33; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
